title.zh: 一步的规律，条件在规律之内：一步上的平衡确切地定下开始立着与不再立着；包含所立者的家族跨过一步下降时，水平改变恰当总水平下降；变化复现恰当它在不下降的步上复现；下降约束变化；只要在任意晚的步有列表覆盖成立者，不再成立的复现就需要开始成立的复现
title.en: The laws of one step, with their condition inside them: balance at a step fixes coming to stand and ceasing to stand exactly; across a step at which a family holding what stands runs down, some standing changes exactly when its total falls; change recurs exactly where it recurs across steps that do not run down; running down bounds change; ceasing recurring needs coming to be recurring wherever some list covers what holds at arbitrarily late steps

claim.zh: 每条规律对每个世界成立；证明用到的条件写在规律之内，是关于该世界在用到它的那些步与关系项上的事实。所作的一步是局部化：对每一步都选的前提使条件处处成立，所以选择结果是推论，不推出任何前提。一步的平衡：流跨过一步在一个家族上平衡，指每个成员步后的水平连同被取的等于步前的水平连同被给的（Flow.BalancesOn）；平衡就是每一步、每个家族上的平衡（Flow.balances_iff_on）。生起需要活跃的给予者：一个条件跨过一步平衡时，它开始立着恰当此前立在零且被给的多于被取的（Flow.BalancesOn.comesToStand_iff），不再立着恰当此前立着且被取的等于它所有的连同被给的（Flow.BalancesOn.ceasesToStand_iff）；跨过没有从平衡的家族取用的一步，成员上升恰当有参与者给予它（Flow.BalancesOn.rises_iff_gives），家族上的耗散排除这一点（Flow.DissipatesOn.still_untaken）；在一步两端都体现、只有活跃者给予它的关系项，生起恰当开始立着，所以由一个不是它自己的活跃给予者给予（Flow.BalancesOn.arises_iff、Flow.BalancesOn.arises_given）；跨过包含它的家族被平衡与耗散的一步，没有什么从无中开始立着（Flow.BalancesOn.comes_from_standing）。静止：家族不重复地包含步前或步后立着的每个条件、流在它上面平衡并耗散时，称它跨过该步下降（Flow.RunsDownOn，不需要封闭）；这时有条件的水平改变恰当家族的总水平下降（Flow.RunsDownOn.changes_iff），家族也封闭时有参与者取用或给予也恰在此时（Flow.RunsDownOn.exchanges_iff）。持续变化需要开放，取确切形式：所立者有普查时，水平在任意晚的步改变，恰当它在任意晚的、所立者不下降的步上改变（Flow.change_recurs_iff），交换连同封闭亦然（Flow.exchange_recurs_iff）；一般形式是 recurs_iff_unmet：在条件之下事件使一个量下降、这个量不上升、它的每次上升都是事件时，事件复现恰当它在不满足条件的步上复现，搜索有界，不用判定。下降约束变化：任何一段步上，不加条件，末步立着的连同总水平下降的步不多于首步的总水平连同它上升的全部（Flow.standing_bounds_change）；总水平只在不下降的步上上升，所以在下降的各步上，末步立着的连同有水平改变的步不多于首步的总水平，不判定水平是否改变（Flow.runsDown_bounds_change、Flow.runsDown_change_bound）。不再存在需要生起：一个列表覆盖一步上成立者，指那里每个成立的成员都在它上面（Covers）；对任何有限列表，段末它成立的连同这一段的不再成立，等于段首它成立的，恰当这一段它没有成员开始成立（cohort_closes_iff）；列表恰好列出第 N 步成立者（ListsAt）、N 之后没有开始成立时，段末成立的连同自 N 以来不再成立的恰好等于第 N 步成立的数目（ceasing_needs_arising）；只要在任意晚的步有列表覆盖成立者，不再成立的复现就需要开始成立的复现（coming_of_ceasing_covered），普查是覆盖每一步的情形（Listed.covered）；不用判定时，列表覆盖第 N 步、此后没有开始成立，不再成立就不复现（Covers.ceasing_not_recurring、Covers.not_not_coming_from）。推论（陈述不变，证明改经这些规律）：Becoming.Openness 的静止定理（Flow.change_stops_unrefuted_around、Flow.exchange_not_recurring_around、Flow.standing_never_rises、Flow.change_lowers 等；前提给出的条件见 Flow.AroundStanding.runsDownClosed）、World.arising_of_ceasing 与 Web.StandingCensus.coming_of_ceasing、Web.Embodied.arises_given、World.enclosure_bounds_change、World.taking_binds_counting、World.enclosed_binds_counting、World.enclosure_bounds_standing 与 World.enclosed_binds_standing。不用伦理前提，不用 Lean 公理。
claim.en: Each law holds of every world; the condition its proof uses is stated inside it, as a fact about the world at the steps and relata where the proof uses it. The move made is localization: a premise selected for every step makes the condition hold everywhere, so the selection results are corollaries and no premise is derived. Balance at a step: the flow balances on a family across a step where each member's level after it, with what was taken from it, is its level before with what was given to it (Flow.BalancesOn); balance is balance on every family across every step (Flow.balances_iff_on). Arising needs an active giver: with balance at a condition across a step, it comes to stand exactly when it stood at nothing and was given more than was taken from it (Flow.BalancesOn.comesToStand_iff), and ceases to stand exactly when it stood and what was taken from it is all it had with all it was given (Flow.BalancesOn.ceasesToStand_iff); across a step at which nothing is taken from a balanced family, a member rises exactly when something taking part gives to it (Flow.BalancesOn.rises_iff_gives), which dissipation on the family excludes (Flow.DissipatesOn.still_untaken); a relatum embodied at both ends of the step and given to only by active formations arises exactly when it comes to stand, so as an active giver other than itself gives to it (Flow.BalancesOn.arises_iff, Flow.BalancesOn.arises_given); nothing comes to stand from nothing across a step at which a family holding it is balanced and dissipated on (Flow.BalancesOn.comes_from_standing). Rest: a family runs down across a step where it holds, without repetition, whatever stands before or after the step, and the flow balances and dissipates on it (Flow.RunsDownOn, with no closure); then some condition's standing changes exactly when the family's total falls (Flow.RunsDownOn.changes_iff), and, with the family closed, something taking part takes or gives exactly then (Flow.RunsDownOn.exchanges_iff). Continued change needs openness, exactly: under a census of what stands, standing changes at arbitrarily late steps exactly when it changes at arbitrarily late steps across which what stands does not run down (Flow.change_recurs_iff), and so with the exchange and closure (Flow.exchange_recurs_iff); the general form is recurs_iff_unmet: where under a condition an event lowers an amount, the amount never rises under the condition, and every rise of it is the event, the event recurs exactly where it recurs without the condition, by a bounded search with no decision. Running down bounds change: over any stretch, with no condition, what stands at its end with the steps at which the total standing fell number at most the total at its start with all it rose (Flow.standing_bounds_change); the total rises only across steps that do not run down, so across steps that run down what stands at the end with the steps at which some standing changed is within the total at the start, with no decision of whether a standing changed (Flow.runsDown_bounds_change, Flow.runsDown_change_bound). Ceasing needs arising: a list covers what holds at a step where every member holding there is on it (Covers); for any finite list, what holds of it at the end of a stretch with its ceasings is what held of it at the start exactly when none of it comes to be across the stretch (cohort_closes_iff); with a list holding exactly what holds at N (ListsAt) and nothing coming to be after N, what holds at the end with what ceased since N number exactly those holding at N (ceasing_needs_arising); ceasing recurring needs coming to be recurring wherever some list covers what holds at arbitrarily late steps (coming_of_ceasing_covered), a census being the case of covering every step (Listed.covered); with no decision, where a list covers step N and nothing comes to be after it, ceasing does not recur (Covers.ceasing_not_recurring, Covers.not_not_coming_from). Corollaries, their statements unchanged and their proofs now through these laws: the rest theorems of Becoming.Openness (Flow.change_stops_unrefuted_around, Flow.exchange_not_recurring_around, Flow.standing_never_rises, Flow.change_lowers and others, the premises supplying the condition by Flow.AroundStanding.runsDownClosed), World.arising_of_ceasing and Web.StandingCensus.coming_of_ceasing, Web.Embodied.arises_given, World.enclosure_bounds_change, World.taking_binds_counting, World.enclosed_binds_counting, World.enclosure_bounds_standing and World.enclosed_binds_standing. No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

hypotheses.zh: 无全局前提：每条规律的条件写在规律之内，是关于该世界在证明用到它的那些步与关系项上的事实（某一步、某个家族上的平衡与耗散，某个关系项的体现，某些步上的列表）。
hypotheses.en: No global premise: the condition of each law is stated inside it, as a fact about the world at the steps and relata where the proof uses it (balance and dissipation on a family across a step, the embodiment of a relatum, a list at some steps).

hypotheses.zh: 所立者的普查：复现定律与下降约束变化用它，作用只是使每步的总水平是一个数；它是尾段各步上的局部条件，不是全局前提。一步的规律不需要普查。
hypotheses.en: A census of what stands: the recurrence laws and running down bounding change use it, only to make the total standing a number at each step; it is a local condition at the steps of a tail, not a global premise. The laws of one step need no census.

hypotheses.zh: 表示：离散的步与自然数的量；耗散中的最小差异（sign 项，Ren 选定的 A）；规律 2 的确切计数用标记（判定该规律的成立），它的不复现形式不用判定。这些是表示的承诺，不是世界的前提。
hypotheses.en: Representation: discrete steps and natural-number amounts; the least difference in dissipation (the sign term, Ren's option A); the exact count of law 2 uses marks (deciding what holds), its form that ceasing does not recur none. These are commitments of the representation, not premises on worlds.

correspondence.zh: 选择定理问的是：在八个前提的某个选择之下，计数服从哪些规律。按 Ren 的转向，本结果改问：每条规律在世界的哪些步与关系项上需要什么。证明表明所需的条件都是局部的：一步的规律只用该步、该条件上的平衡；静止只用跨过那些步、包含所立者的家族的下降，不需要封闭；下降约束变化对所立者不需要体现；不再存在需要生起只用覆盖成立者的列表，不需要普查。前提对每一步成立时，这些条件在每一步成立，选择结果因此是推论。读法（AI，待 Ren）：前提约束的第一部分规律，是每一步及其关系项的规律；前提是使它们的条件处处成立的一种方式。
correspondence.en: The selection theorems ask which laws the counts obey under a selection of the eight premises. Following Ren's redirect, this result asks instead what each law needs, at which steps and relata of the world. The proofs show the conditions are local: the laws of one step use balance only at that step and condition; rest uses only a family holding what stands running down across those steps, with no closure; running down bounds the change of what stands with no embodiment; ceasing needs arising uses only a list covering what holds, with no census. Where the premises hold at every step, these conditions hold at every step, so the selection results are corollaries. Reading (AI, pending Ren): the laws of Part I that the premises bound are laws of each step and its relata, and the premises are one way of making their conditions hold everywhere.

detail.zh: 复用开始成立与不再成立（ComesToBe、CeasesToBe）、一段上的恒等式（over_stretch）与标记（mark）。
detail.en: Reuses coming to be and ceasing to be (ComesToBe, CeasesToBe), the identity over a stretch (over_stretch) and marks (mark).

output.zh: 一段步上一个量的末值连同下降等于初值连同上升；有限家族中开始成立与不再成立同步。
output.en: Over a stretch an amount at its end with its falls is its start with its rises; in a finite family coming to be and ceasing to be keep pace.

input.zh: 下降约束变化以该恒等式读总水平；不再存在需要生起把同步局部化为覆盖成立者的列表。
input.en: Running down bounds change reads the total standing through that identity; ceasing needs arising localizes keeping pace to a list covering what holds.

detail.en: Reuses the balance of a flow (Flow.Balances).

output.zh: 平衡的流：每一步每个条件上，步后的水平连同被取的等于步前的水平连同被给的。
output.en: A balanced flow: at every step and condition, the level after with what was taken is the level before with what was given.

input.zh: 一步的平衡把它限于一步与一个家族（BalancesOn），平衡就是处处的一步平衡。
input.en: Balance at a step restricts it to one step and one family (BalancesOn), balance being balance at every step.

detail.zh: 复用家族上的耗散与封闭（Flow.DissipatesOn、Flow.ClosedAt）、耗散（Flow.Dissipative）与平衡的流跨过被耗散的步下降（Flow.Balances.runs_down）。
detail.en: Reuses dissipation and closure on a family (Flow.DissipatesOn, Flow.ClosedAt), dissipation (Flow.Dissipative) and a balanced flow running down across a step dissipated on (Flow.Balances.runs_down).

output.zh: 被耗散的家族的存量下降至少为取用它的形成数。
output.en: A family dissipated on runs down by at least the number of formations taking from it.

input.zh: 同一下降只用该步、该家族上的平衡（BalancesOn.runs_down），再加上下降的确切条件。
input.en: The same running down uses balance only at that step and family (BalancesOn.runs_down), with the exact condition of running down added.

conditions.zh: 一步、一个家族上的平衡与耗散。
conditions.en: Balance and dissipation on one family across one step.

output.zh: 普查的平衡：段末的列表连同不再成立的等于段首的列表连同开始成立的。
output.en: The census balance: the list at the end with what ceased is the list at the start with what came.

input.zh: 对任何有限列表，同一平衡恰当这一段没有成员开始成立时成立（cohort_closes_iff），普查是覆盖每一步的情形。
input.en: For any finite list the same balance holds exactly when none of it comes to be across the stretch (cohort_closes_iff), a census being the case of covering every step.

detail.zh: 计划 P48：按 Ren 2026-10-11 的转向，Ren 先点名的四条规律对每个世界重述；这不是无公理的整体演绎。
detail.en: Plan P48: following Ren's redirect of 11 October, the four laws Ren named first restated for every world; this is not the deduction of the whole without axioms.

detail.zh: 分辨率一线：把细分算作给予时每一分辨率下都静止；超出整单位的量的检验从这里接上。
detail.en: The resolution line: rest at every resolution with the refinement counted as a giving; the test with amounts finer than whole units connects here.

detail.zh: 已局部的一次交换的规律（在一个家族、一步上陈述）；本结果把静止与生起的规律化为同样的形式。
detail.en: The laws of one exchange already stated locally, on a family across a step; this result brings the laws of rest and arising to the same form.

detail.zh: World.sourcedQueue：流平衡、满足耗散（只约束封闭的家族），成员却从无中开始立着；由 Flow.BalancesOn.comes_from_standing，那一步上没有包含它的家族被耗散。所以局部条件是包含该关系项的家族上的耗散；前提只在家族封闭处给出它。
detail.en: World.sourcedQueue: the flow balances and is dissipative (which binds only closed families), yet members come to stand from nothing; by Flow.BalancesOn.comes_from_standing no family holding such a member is dissipated on across that step. So the local condition is dissipation on a family holding the relatum, which the premise supplies only where that family is closed.

detail.zh: 边界：下降约束变化是不等式而非当且仅当；确切的是 over_stretch 的恒等式与一步的当且仅当。复现定律与该界在尾段各步用所立者的普查，一步的规律不用；无穷多立着时总水平不是一个数，要去掉普查须改变量的表示。
detail.en: Boundary: running down bounding change is an inequality, not an iff; what is exact is the identity of over_stretch with the one-step iffs. The recurrence laws and the bound use a census of what stands at the steps of a tail, the laws of one step none; where infinitely many stand the total standing is not a number, and dropping the census would change the representation of amounts.

detail.zh: Listed.lpo_of_few：不再成立不复现的形式不用判定，但给出明确的最后一步一般地需要全知；所以规律 2 与规律 1 以复现的否定陈述。
detail.en: Listed.lpo_of_few: the form in which ceasing does not recur needs no decision, but naming an explicit last step needs omniscience in general; so laws 1 and 2 are stated as negated recurrences.

limitations.zh: 不推出任何前提：表示之内各前提仍是偶然的、彼此独立的（World.contingent、World.independent）；所作的是局部化，不是重新奠定表示。下降约束变化是不等式，它的确切形式是 over_stretch 的恒等式连同一步的当且仅当；复现定律与下降约束变化用所立者的普查，要在无穷多立着时去掉它，须改变量的表示（属于 Ren 的决定）；规律 1 的复现与规律 3 的界用最小差异（选项 A），超出整单位的量下各条是否成立尚未检验，静止由分辨率一线覆盖（R4）；只对离散步陈述，较粗的步待局部化的 Sampling 落地，连续时间未研究；规律 2 的确切计数要求判定，不复现形式不要求；“封闭约束变化”的名称是 Ren 的，证明表明约束变化的是下降，封闭是前提给出下降的方式；规律 2 一节由另一会话（0 axiom completeness）起草并验证；不评价生起、止息或静止；名称（BalancesOn、RunsDownOn、RunsDown、RunsDownClosed、Covers、ListsAt、NoneComes、recurs_iff_unmet 等）是 AI 按 Ren 2026-10-10 的命名准则所选，读法仍由 Ren 定。
limitations.en: No premise is derived: within the representation the premises remain contingent and independent (World.contingent, World.independent); the move is localization, not a re-founding of the representation. Running down bounding change is an inequality, its exact form being the identity of over_stretch with the one-step iffs; the recurrence laws and the bound use a census of what stands, and dropping it where infinitely many stand would change the representation of amounts, which is Ren's decision; the recurrence of law 1 and the bounds of law 3 use the least difference (option A), and whether each law survives amounts finer than whole units is not yet tested, rest being covered by the resolution line (R4); stated for discrete steps, coarser steps awaiting the localized Sampling and continuous time not studied; law 2's exact count needs a decision, its form that ceasing does not recur none; the name ‘closure bounds change’ is Ren's, and the proof shows that what bounds change is running down, closure being how the premises supply it; the section on law 2 was drafted and verified by another session (0 axiom completeness); evaluates neither arising, ceasing nor rest; the names (BalancesOn, RunsDownOn, RunsDown, RunsDownClosed, Covers, ListsAt, NoneComes, recurs_iff_unmet and others) are the AI's choice under Ren's naming criteria of 10 October, and readings remain Ren's.
